item.title: DOJ investigates Trump ally Corey Lewandowski's DHS actions after IG referral
item.description: Lewandowski, a longtime Trump ally, was a top aide to ousted DHS Secretary Kristi Noem.

item.title: Meghan "deeply distressed" as father faces child abuse material probe
item.description: Thomas Markle, estranged father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, faces a Philippines probe over alleged possession of child abuse material.

item.title: Trump defends Ramaswamy ad as top Republicans urge its removal
item.description: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine and Iowa Republican Senate candidate Rep. Ashley Hinson both said the campaign should stop airing the ad.

item.title: Five hurt in thwarted potential major attack at Israeli checkpoint
item.description: Five people were injured in a shooting at an Israeli military checkpoint in the West Bank, prompting Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to close off the area.
